compute.service: existing Databricks Free Edition serverless Jobs

quota_boundary: Free Edition is no-cost and quota-limited. A quota shutdown may interrupt the one-shot Job after some Delta commits. Treat the result as UNCERTAIN_REQUIRES_READBACK; independently inspect the protected ledger, Jobs run, all 23 target IDs, versions, histories, counts and lineage before deriving an exact remaining-work checkpoint. Never replay the original submission. A later continuation requires a separately signed operation-specific grant and immutable remaining-work manifest after capacity returns. If the installed V3 extension cannot provide this, V3 execution is blocked.
